---
title: "About"
---

Site and slides made with [Quarto](https://quarto.org),
[Positron](https://positron.posit.co) and [R](https://www.r-project.org). The
build environment is manged with
[`{targets}`](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/) and
[`{renv}`](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/index.html). Thanks to the
indefatigable [Andrew Heiss](https://www.andrewheiss.com) for leading by example
with the `{targets}` setup and for making his configuration available.

The main typeface used on the site and slides is [Tenso
Slab](https://www.fontspring.com/fonts/exljbris/tenso-slab). The monospace font
is [Berkeley Mono](https://berkeleygraphics.com/typefaces/berkeley-mono/).
